record.original_question: Let P be a family of at least two essentially distinct integer polynomials, and let dmin(P) be the least d such that the Host–Kra factor Zd,T is characteristic for mean convergence of the averages (1/N) Σ T^{p1(n)} f1 · ... · T^{pℓ(n)} fℓ. Must one always have dmin(P) ≤ |P| - 1?

evidence.quote: Given a family of polynomials P, we denote by dmin(P) the minimal value of d(P) that works in the previous theorem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu,T)$ be an invertible measure-preserving system on a probability space, and for each integer $k\ge 0$ let $Z_{k,T}$ denote the $k$-th Host–Kra factor of $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu,T)$ (so $Z_{0,T}$ is the trivial factor, $Z_{1,T}$ is the Kronecker factor, and in general $Z_{k,T}$ is the inverse limit of $k$-step nilfactors of $T$).

Given a finite family $P=\{p_1,\dots,p_\ell\}$ of integer-valued polynomials in one variable, say that the factor $Z_{d,T}$ is characteristic for $P$ if for every system $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu,T)$ and all $f_1,\dots,f_\ell\in L^\infty(\mu)$,
$$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac1N\sum_{n=1}^{N}\Big(\prod_{i=1}^{\ell}T^{p_i(n)}f_i-\prod_{i=1}^{\ell}T^{p_i(n)}\mathbb{E}(f_i\mid Z_{d,T})\Big)=0$$
in $L^2(\mu)$, and in particular the limit on the left of (i.e. of $\frac1N\sum_{n=1}^N\prod_i T^{p_i(n)}f_i$) exists in $L^2(\mu)$.

Two integer polynomials are called essentially distinct if their difference is not a constant. Assume $P$ contains at least two essentially distinct polynomials, and let
$$d_{\min}(P)=\min\{d\ge 0: Z_{d,T}\text{ is characteristic for }P\}.$$
Set $|P|=\ell$.

Prove or disprove: for every such family $P$ with $|P|\ge 2$,
$$d_{\min}(P)\le |P|-1.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in Frantzikinakis' survey of open problems on multiple ergodic averages (2011) and is consistent with subsequent literature treating sharp characteristic factor degrees as an open question. Recent work (e.g., joint ergodicity results of Frantzikinakis–Kuca and others, 2021–2024) has clarified characteristic factors for many polynomial families but does not establish the universal bound $d_{\min}(P)\le |P|-1$. No source found establishing or refuting the bound in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on multiple ergodic averages
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of open problems on multiple ergodic averages including questions on minimal characteristic factor degrees for polynomial families.
status_evidence.claim: The bound d_min(P) ≤ |P|-1 is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Joint ergodicity of sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Subsequent works identify characteristic factors for various polynomial families but do not prove the universal bound in question.
status_evidence.claim: More recent results refine characteristic factors for specific families without resolving the general bound.
